items.title: Celebrate 110 years of national parks with Maps, Search, and Gemini
items.summary: What people are searching in the lead-up to National Parks Week — plus, how Ask Maps, AI Mode, and the Gemini app can help turn your wanderlust into a well-planned adventure.

items.title: Previewing the Model Hardware Standard
items.summary: We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.

items.title: Beneficial Deployments
items.summary: Powerful AI could compress decades of scientific and economic progress into years and help solve some of the hardest problems we face.

items.title: Better answers, broader thinking: What students gain from ChatGPT and critical-thinking training
items.summary: In a randomized experiment with more than 1,000 students, access to ChatGPT and training in causal reasoning improved student work in complementary ways.

items.title: Expanding OpenAI’s presence in Brazil
items.summary: With the launch of commercial operations in Brazil, we’re deepening our long-term commitment to the country and helping turn rapid AI adoption into broad economic and social benefits.

items.title: Enabling independent research on how people use Claude
items.summary: Earlier this year, we ran a pilot giving external researchers access to aggregate, real-world Claude usage data.
